issue.title: _openai_realtime_ws_url does not validate host allowing SSRF via env vars
issue.actual_behavior: _openai_realtime_ws_url() normalises the base_url scheme (http→ws, https→wss) but does NOT validate the host against ALLOWED_VOICE_HOSTS. The VOICE_TTS_OPENAI_REALTIME_WS_URL env var flows directly into this function. An attacker who controls that env var can set it to wss://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ or wss://internal-service:8080/v1/realtime and the server will open a WebSocket connection with an Authorization: Bearer header to that internal URL — a classic SSRF. The ElevenLabs path (_join_url) is protected but this OpenAI Realtime path bypasses host validation entirely.
issue.expected_behavior: _openai_realtime_ws_url() should validate the parsed hostname against ALLOWED_VOICE_HOSTS before constructing the WebSocket URL, rejecting any host not in the allowlist with a ValueError.
repro_steps: Note _openai_realtime_ws_url() normalises scheme but never inspects parsed.hostname
Observe it returns a valid WebSocket URL to the metadata endpoint — no validation error raised
issue.affected_workflow: voice-comms OpenAI Realtime TTS WebSocket connections leak Authorization headers to attacker-controlled hosts via SSRF

evidence.before_after_proof: BEFORE: _openai_realtime_ws_url() at lines 1960-1964 strips trailing '/', normalises http→ws / https→wss, appends /realtime and query params. It never calls urllib.parse.urlparse() or inspects hostname. Any host including 169.254.169.254, internal-service, localhost passes without error. AFTER: ALLOWED_VOICE_HOSTS frozenset = {api.elevenlabs.io, api.openai.com} is defined at module level (line 39). _openai_realtime_ws_url() now parses the normalised URL, extracts hostname, lowercases it, and raises ValueError if hostname not in ALLOWED_VOICE_HOSTS.

proposed_fix.approach: Add ALLOWED_VOICE_HOSTS frozenset allowlist at module level containing api.elevenlabs.io and api.openai.com. In _openai_realtime_ws_url(), after normalising the scheme, parse the URL with urllib.parse.urlparse(), extract hostname, and reject any host not in ALLOWED_VOICE_HOSTS with a ValueError.
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: All 100 tests pass (90 existing + 10 new). Added test_openai_realtime_ws_url_rejects_hosts_not_in_allowlist (parametrised: 169.254.169.254, internal-service:8080, evil.attacker.com, localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254 https). Added test_openai_realtime_ws_url_accepts_allowed_hosts (wss://api.openai.com, https://api.openai.com, http://api.openai.com). Added test_openai_realtime_ws_url_defaults_when_base_url_empty.

review_claim.duplicate_notes: Searched open PRs and issues in vibeforge1111/spark-voice-comms for _openai_realtime_ws_url, openai-realtime host validation, SSRF in the realtime path. The existing PR #193 fixes _join_url (ElevenLabs path) but does not touch _openai_realtime_ws_url. This PR covers the OpenAI Realtime path specifically.
review_claim.risk_notes: Low risk change. Only affects _openai_realtime_ws_url() which is called at 1 location (line 1696 for TTS request construction). The ALLOWED_VOICE_HOSTS frozenset is defined at module level and shared with _join_url on the other fix branch — adding a new provider requires adding one hostname to the frozenset.
